source: Native AWS HTTPS endpoints; raw AWS JSON requests and responses
scope: Two owned Lite pools: hidden-user SRP/challenge crossover and reserved-address alias collisions; no message delivery
redaction: Passwords, client secrets, hashes, bearer tokens, sessions and SRP secret blocks/signatures replaced by SHA256-labeled placeholders. Decoded synthetic-user claims and public JWKS retained. No credentials captured.
limitations: No SMTP/SMS, federation, hosted UI, OAuth/custom domains, MFA, device remembering, Lambda triggers, custom attributes or paid add-ons.
Lite is explicitly selected to avoid add-ons; omitted UserPoolTier default is not captured.
No token expiry waiting, temporary-password expiry, refresh rotation, cross-account, or cross-region claims.
JWT signature/claim verification is offline cryptographic evidence, not evidence of revocation status; GetUser and refresh requests independently exercise server acceptance.

Admission slice sends deliberately invalid zero-byte SRP signatures; it does not claim these are valid SRP proofs. JWT verification and refresh lifecycle are covered by the separate full login fixture.
